summary: A Delivery Review that is invalidated and published again can open its PR again on the machine that opened it: the new prepare-pr-creation intent takes over the provider receipt the earlier intent left, and open-pr records the PR the provider still shows without a provider call, where it used to refuse because a different provider receipt already existed. The earlier receipt still refuses, now under DELIVERY_PR_UNCERTAIN, when its provider call started and no exact Delivery PR is visible, or when it names a PR other than the exact Delivery PR.
